summary.text: Rob Kauffman is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 89, which he has represented since December 2004, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He previously served as vice chair of the Greene County Board of Supervisors.

paragraphs.text: Kauffman earned a B.A. in political science from American University.
In the 2023-2024 session Kauffman chaired the House Judiciary Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
